original_prompt: Write a Helm chart deploying a multi-container Pod (sidecar pattern): main application container and a Fluent Bit log-shipping sidecar with a shared volume.
user_message_sent:
Target IaC language: Helm chart templates (YAML; provide Chart.yaml, values.yaml, and templates/ as separate files concatenated with '---' YAML document separators and clearly labeled '# FILE: <path>' comments)

Task: Write a Helm chart deploying a multi-container Pod (sidecar pattern): main application container and a Fluent Bit log-shipping sidecar with a shared volume.

Output only the Helm chart templates (YAML; provide Chart.yaml, values.yaml, and templates/ as separate files concatenated with '---' YAML document separators and clearly labeled '# FILE: <path>' comments) code, no commentary or markdown fences.
raw_response:
# FILE: Chart.yaml
apiVersion: v2
name: sidecar-logger
description: Production Helm chart for multi-container Pod with main app and Fluent Bit sidecar
type: application
version: 1.0.0
appVersion: "1.25.0"
---
# FILE: values.yaml
replicaCount: 2
image:
  app:
    repository: nginx
    tag: "1.25-alpine"
    pullPolicy: IfNotPresent
  fluentbit:
    repository: fluent/fluent-bit
    tag: "2.1.10"
    pullPolicy: IfNotPresent
sharedVolume:
  name: shared-logs
  mountPath: /var/log/app
resources:
  app:
    requests:
      cpu: 100m
      memory: 128Mi
    limits:
      cpu: 500m
      memory: 512Mi
  fluentbit:
    requests:
      cpu: 50m
      memory: 64Mi
    limits:
      cpu: 200m
      memory: 256Mi
securityContext:
  runAsNonRoot: true
  runAsUser: 1000
  fsGroup: 2000
podSecurityContext:
  seccompProfile:
    type: RuntimeDefault
affinity:
  podAntiAffinity:
    preferredDuringSchedulingIgnoredDuringExecution:
    - weight: 100
      podAffinityTerm:
        labelSelector:
          matchExpressions:
          - key: app.kubernetes.io/name
            operator: In
            values:
            - sidecar-logger
        topologyKey: kubernetes.io/hostname
---
# FILE: templates/_helpers.tpl
{{- define "sidecar-logger.labels" -}}
helm.sh/chart: {{ include "sidecar-logger.chart" . }}
{{ include "sidecar-logger.selectorLabels" . }}
app.kubernetes.io/version: {{ .Chart.AppVersion | quote }}
app.kubernetes.io/managed-by: {{ .Release.Service }}
{{- end -}}
{{- define "sidecar-logger.selectorLabels" -}}
app.kubernetes.io/name: {{ include "sidecar-logger.name" . }}
app.kubernetes.io/instance: {{ .Release.Name }}
{{- end -}}
{{- define "sidecar-logger.name" -}}sidecar-logger{{- end -}}
{{- define "sidecar-logger.chart" -}}{{ .Chart.Name }}-{{ .Chart.Version | replace "+" "_" }}{{- end -}}
---
# FILE: templates/deployment.yaml
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: {{ include "sidecar-logger.name" . }}
  labels:
    {{- include "sidecar-logger.labels" . | nindent 4 }}
spec:
  replicas: {{ .Values.replicaCount }}
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      {{- include "sidecar-logger.selectorLabels" . | nindent 6 }}
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        {{- include "sidecar-logger.selectorLabels" . | nindent 8 }}
    spec:
      securityContext:
        {{- toYaml .Values.podSecurityContext | nindent 8 }}
      affinity:
        {{- toYaml .Values.affinity | nindent 8 }}
      volumes:
        - name: {{ .Values.sharedVolume.name }}
          emptyDir: {}
      containers:
        - name: app
          image: "{{ .Values.image.app.repository }}:{{ .Values.image.app.tag }}"
          imagePullPolicy: {{ .Values.image.app.pullPolicy }}
          securityContext:
            {{- toYaml .Values.securityContext | nindent 12 }}
          volumeMounts:
            - name: {{ .Values.sharedVolume.name }}
              mountPath: {{ .Values.sharedVolume.mountPath }}
          resources:
            {{- toYaml .Values.resources.app | nindent 12 }}
          ports:
            - containerPort: 80
              name: http
        - name: fluentbit
          image: "{{ .Values.image.fluentbit.repository }}:{{ .Values.image.fluentbit.tag }}"
          imagePullPolicy: {{ .Values.image.fluentbit.pullPolicy }}
          securityContext:
            {{- toYaml .Values.securityContext | nindent 12 }}
          volumeMounts:
            - name: {{ .Values.sharedVolume.name }}
              mountPath: {{ .Values.sharedVolume.mountPath }}
              readOnly: true
          resources:
            {{- toYaml .Values.resources.fluentbit | nindent 12 }}
          command: ["/fluent-bit/bin/fluent-bit", "-c", "/fluent-bit/etc/fluent-bit.conf"]
